Today I was awarded my plaque for 5 years at Apple. I find it timely given I’m also in the middle of reading The Alchemist. A theme from the book that stuck with me this morning was every journey starts with beginner’s luck and ends with the victors being severely tested. My journey at Apple can be counted in years, but even more meaningful is the variety of products I’ve had the honor of influencing and meaningful relationships that have been forged. Landing any job takes a little bit of luck but a successful career takes effort, patience, drive and the willingness to evolve. When I look back, my evolution here is apparent in more ways than my resume can show. What I'm most grateful for is the way I've learned to think about products, people, and the role they play in shaping one another. While I take the time to reflect, it’s interesting to think of how tech is going to evolve with AI especially at Apple (this may be one of the last plaques signed with Tim as CEO!). I’m excited to continue my personal legend and for what the future holds. ...more ...more

Excited to share that I have graduated from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign with my Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in Control and Robotics. My time at UIUC has been filled with challenging projects, valuable experiences, and meaningful friendships. I’m grateful for the opportunities to work on robotics, manufacturing, analytics, and interdisciplinary engineering projects while learning from so many talented professors, mentors, teammates, and friends. I would like to sincerely thank everyone who supported me throughout this journey, including my family, classmates, professors, and colleagues.
